summary: The 8/10 slate could NOT be established from available tier-3 sources. No card was built and no forecast was registered. This is the new gate working as designed, not a tooling failure.

what_happened.detail: Returned pitcher/team pairings that contradict this season's known rosters: MacKenzie Gore listed for HOU (he started for TEX on the 8/8 board), Casey Mize for SEA (traded to SD ~8/5), Logan Henderson for ATH (he is MIL), Hunter Dobbins for DET (Boston). Also proposed 'Orioles vs Phillies', which no other source shows.

what_happened.verdict: PARTIAL — 6 of ~10 games, times likely Pacific
what_happened.detail: BOS@TOR, NYM@ATL, BAL@MIN, PHI@STL, TEX@LAA, COL@AZ. Directly contradicts source #1 (which had BAL vs PHI as one game; here they are in two different games).

BAL @ MIN at Target Field, T. Rogers (BAL) vs D. Kremer (MIN). Kremer-as-Twin is consistent with the 8/5 record in this repo, so this pairing is coherent. It also shows source #1 garbled the same two pitchers onto the wrong teams.

cross_source_agreement.BAL@MIN: 2 of 3 sources, coherent with repo history — the ONLY matchup that clears two-source agreement

why_no_card: Under the controls added today, an outcome label or a forecast input may not rest on a single unverified tier-3 snippet. Two independent pulls disagreed on the fundamental composition of the slate; assembling a card from the overlap would be exactly the reconstruction behaviour that produced the 2026-08-08 LAA@MIA row.
to_unblock: A tier-1 slate source: the owner's board/screenshot (the proven path), or an MLB.com schedule capture. With that, the card builds and forecasts register PROSPECTIVELY (DIAGNOSTIC_PROSPECTIVE) before first pitch — which is the evidence class the registry backfill could not create for 8/6-8/9.
note: Earliest listed first pitch is ~4:07pm PT / 7:07pm ET, so a tier-1 source received in the next few hours still permits a genuine pre-pitch freeze.
